questions.stem: Cartographer's projection 1 shows a project with benefit-cost ratio 1.4. What does that imply?

options.text: Benefits exceed costs, so the project is efficient

questions.explanation: A ratio above 1 means benefits exceed costs. Break-even requires 1.0 and zero benefits would give 0.

questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Explain adverse selection in a market
questions.stem: Cartographer's projection 3 asks why bad products drive out good ones. Explain.

answer.exemplar: When sellers know quality but buyers do not, buyers offer average prices, so high-quality sellers exit, leaving a market of lemons.

questions.explanation: Information asymmetry leads to average pricing, driving high-quality sellers out and leaving lemons.

questions.explanation: Ignoring external costs makes private cost too low, causing overproduction.
